summary: Fury Gold Mines Ltd filed a Form 6-K with unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, and MD&A. The filing reports routine results, including a net income of C$0.19 million for the six-month period, cash of C$8.7 million, marketable securities of C$45.9 million, and investments in associates. No special-situation transaction is announced. The registrant is an exploration company reporting standard financial performance. This is a routine periodic report requiring no special-situation classification.
